title: Early Release of Draft Budget Statement for Public Consultation
what_it_is: Early Release of Draft Budget Statement for Public Consultation

sections.label: Year-round Budget preparations
sections.summary: Preparations and consultations for the Budget take place all year round.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In fact, preparations and consultations for the Budget take place all year round.

sections.label: Budget 2017 REACH feedback exercise
sections.summary: Feedback gathering intensifies by early December; for Budget 2017, REACH held Listening Points across Singapore from 10 December 2016 to 8 January 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The feedback gathering is intensified around the end of the year, typically by early December, in a more formal Budget feedback exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For Budget 2017, REACH had Listening Points across Singapore over 10 December 2016 to 8 January 2017 to provide accessible, open booths for Singaporeans to give their views for Budget 2017.

sections.label: Timing of consultation
sections.summary: Companies and stakeholders often prefer to give views closer to the Budget as the economic situation and business concerns become clearer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: On the timing of consultation, we have found from our interactions with companies and stakeholders that many of them would prefer to give their views closer to the Budget as the economic situation for the coming year is clearer and business concerns become clearer.

sections.label: Pioneer Generation Package genesis
sections.summary: The Pioneer Generation Package began in Our Singapore Conversation in 2012 and took two years to put together; this year's Budget has the GIA and SME Go Digital.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For example, the Pioneer Generation Package is something which had its genesis in Our Singapore Conversation which started in 2012.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, it took two years to put together that particular package.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We also have, for example, in this year's Budget, the Global Innovation Alliance (GIA) and SME Go Digital programme.

sections.label: Themes instead of draft Budget
sections.summary: Rather than releasing a draft Budget in detail, themes are discussed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: What we do is, rather than releasing a draft Budget in detail, as I mentioned earlier, we talk about themes.

sections.label: Budget Statement and Parliament approval
sections.summary: The Budget is put together and delivered at the Budget Statement, which is still subject to Parliament's approval.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We put it together and then it is delivered at the Budget Statement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But the Budget Statement is actually still subject to the approval of Parliament.
